PART 1 — rewrite sql/v3/migrations/010_v3_system_search_body_type_counts.sql (never applied anywhere governed; no file pins its current hash). New content, in this exact order inside one transaction: BEGIN; SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '30s'; ONE ALTER TABLE v3_derived.system_search adding the same 18 columns as today as integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with NO inline CHECK; ONE ALTER TABLE adding the 18 CHECK constraints NOT VALID, with exactly the names PostgreSQL would have auto-generated for the inline form: system_search_<column>_check (e.g. system_search_elw_count_check; walkable_count's check is CHECK(walkable_count BETWEEN 0 AND landable_count) named system_search_walkable_count_check); the existing CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v3_app.system_search; COMMIT. The first non-comment statement must be BEGIN; and the last COMMIT; (scripts/operator/v3_production_migrate.py terminal_commit_span requires it). Header comment must state: why NOT VALID (bounded runner COMMAND_TIMEOUT=120 s; validated CHECKs scan ~198.5M rows under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE), that the constraints are enforced for every subsequent INSERT/UPDATE, that existing rows satisfy them by construction (DEFAULT 0; 004 enforces landable_count >= 0), and that VALIDATE CONSTRAINT is a separate governed operation (rollout step 3). Verify with git diff that the column list and view are otherwise unchanged.
